ImageDescription.value:
THREE MEN ON A BRIDE 
I love travelling to different cities and shooting their Food, Culture,People and Architecture . But,what I mostly love is explore places early in the. mornings before the sunrises. There's something new I always find before each sunrise.
As I was passing by the streets of a colony in Allahabad, trying to shoot something interesting, I came across a bridge, huge and symmetric,called the 'Naini Bridge' . I stood there at the entrance of the bridge taking the cold breeze and setting my camera to shoot it. As I got my eyes to the view finder, all set to shoot and image, I heard bicycle bells ringing behind me approaching the bridge. Three men individually on bicycles, I assumed were colleagues got on to the bridge singing and humming with the morning. I stood there looking at them pass by me and then instantly took my camera and shot this beautiful frame which I call, ' Three men on a Bridge '. Oh, how I know the empty bridge wouldn't look as beautiful as it is in the frame
